#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

log_tag="minio-offsite-rsync-auth"
allowed_source="/owned/archive"
original_command="${SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND:-}"

deny() {
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Denied command: ${original_command}"
  echo "Access denied." >&2
  exit 1
}

[[ -n "${original_command}" ]] || deny

read -r -a cmd_parts <<< "${original_command}"
cmd_count="$(printf '%s\n' "${cmd_parts[@]}" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
[[ "${cmd_count}" -ge 5 ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[0]}" == "rsync" ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[1]}" == "--server" ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[2]}" == "--sender" ]] || deny

requested_path="${cmd_parts[-1]}"
requested_path="${requested_path%/}"
requested_path="${requested_path%/.}"
[[ "${requested_path}" == "${allowed_source}" ]] || deny

exec /usr/bin/rsync "${cmd_parts[@]:1}"
resources.mail-backup-stage.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

stage_dir="/owned/stage/"
vmail_dir="/owned/vmail/"

if ! mountpoint -q /mnt/cryptdata; then
  echo "FATAL: /mnt/cryptdata is not mounted" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -d "${vmail_dir}" ]]; then
  echo "FATAL: vmail directory not found at ${vmail_dir}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

shopt -s nullglob
found_maildir="false"
for domain_dir in "${vmail_dir}"/*/; do
  for user_dir in "${domain_dir}"*/; do
    if [[ -d "${user_dir}cur" && -d "${user_dir}new" && -d "${user_dir}tmp" ]]; then
      found_maildir="true"
      break 2
    fi
  done
done
shopt -u nullglob

if [[ "${found_maildir}" != "true" ]]; then
  echo "FATAL: No valid Maildir structure found under ${vmail_dir}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "${stage_dir}"

db_tmp="${stage_dir}/database.dump.tmp"
cfg_tmp="${stage_dir}/config.tar.gz.tmp"
manifest_tmp="${stage_dir}/manifest.yml.tmp"

runuser -u postgres -- pg_dump --format=custom --dbname=mail > "${db_tmp}"
mv -f "${db_tmp}" "${stage_dir}/database.dump"

tar -czf "${cfg_tmp}" \
  /etc/postfix /etc/dovecot /etc/opendkim /etc/rspamd
mv -f "${cfg_tmp}" "${stage_dir}/config.tar.gz"

cat > "${manifest_tmp}" <<MANIFEST
timestamp: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
host: $(hostname -f)
components: [database, config]
MANIFEST
mv -f "${manifest_tmp}" "${stage_dir}/manifest.yml"
resources.mail-offsite-allow.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

log_tag="mail-offsite-rsync-auth"
allowed_vmail="/owned/vmail"
allowed_stage="/owned/stage"
stage_script="/usr/local/sbin/mail-backup-stage.sh"
original_command="${SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND:-}"

deny() {
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Denied command: ${original_command}"
  echo "Access denied." >&2
  exit 1
}

[[ -n "${original_command}" ]] || deny

if [[ "${original_command}" == "${stage_script}" ]]; then
  exec "${stage_script}"
fi

read -r -a cmd_parts <<< "${original_command}"
cmd_count="$(printf '%s\n' "${cmd_parts[@]}" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
[[ "${cmd_count}" -ge 5 ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[0]}" == "rsync" ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[1]}" == "--server" ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[2]}" == "--sender" ]] || deny

requested_path="${cmd_parts[-1]}"
requested_path="${requested_path%/}"
requested_path="${requested_path%/.}"

case "${requested_path}" in
  "${allowed_vmail}"|"${allowed_stage}") ;;
  *) deny ;;
esac

exec /usr/bin/rsync "${cmd_parts[@]:1}"
resources.mail-restore-allow.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

log_tag="mail-restore-rsync-auth"
original_command="${SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND:-}"

deny() {
  logger -t "${log_tag}" "Denied command: ${original_command}"
  echo "Access denied." >&2
  exit 1
}

[[ -n "${original_command}" ]] || deny

if [[ "${original_command}" == "zfs list -t snapshot -o name,creation -s creation tank/backups/mail" ]]; then
  exec /usr/sbin/zfs list -t snapshot -o name,creation -s creation tank/backups/mail
fi

if [[ "${original_command}" == "zfs list tank/backups/mail" ]]; then
  exec /usr/sbin/zfs list tank/backups/mail
fi

if [[ "${original_command}" == "zfs list tank/restore" ]]; then
  exec /usr/sbin/zfs list tank/restore
fi

if [[ "${original_command}" == "zfs create tank/restore" ]]; then
  exec /usr/sbin/zfs create tank/restore
fi

if [[ "${original_command}" =~ ^zfs[[:space:]]+clone[[:space:]]+tank/backups/mail@([A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+)[[:space:]]+tank/restore/mail$ ]]; then
  snapshot_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
  exec /usr/sbin/zfs clone "tank/backups/mail@${snapshot_name}" "tank/restore/mail"
fi

if [[ "${original_command}" == "zfs destroy tank/restore/mail" ]]; then
  exec /usr/sbin/zfs destroy tank/restore/mail
fi

read -r -a cmd_parts <<< "${original_command}"
cmd_count="$(printf '%s\n' "${cmd_parts[@]}" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
[[ "${cmd_count}" -ge 5 ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[0]}" == "rsync" ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[1]}" == "--server" ]] || deny
[[ "${cmd_parts[2]}" == "--sender" ]] || deny

requested_path="${cmd_parts[-1]}"
requested_path="${requested_path%/}"
requested_path="${requested_path%/.}"
[[ "${requested_path}" == /* ]] || deny
[[ "${requested_path}" == *".."* ]] && deny
[[ "${requested_path}" == *"//"* ]] && deny

case "${requested_path}" in
  /tank/backups/mail|/tank/backups/mail/vmail|/tank/backups/mail/vmail/*|/tank/backups/mail/stage|/tank/backups/mail/stage/*|/tank/restore/mail|/tank/restore/mail/vmail|/tank/restore/mail/vmail/*|/tank/restore/mail/stage|/tank/restore/mail/stage/*) ;;
  *) deny ;;
esac

exec /usr/bin/rsync "${cmd_parts[@]:1}"
